title: Backpack with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#4fb2ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2b7fd6'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- straps -->
  <path d='M30 24 Q26 50 30 82' fill='none' stroke='#7a5230' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 24 Q74 50 70 82' fill='none' stroke='#7a5230' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 24 Q26 50 30 82' fill='none' stroke='#a9743f' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 24 Q74 50 70 82' fill='none' stroke='#a9743f' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- main body -->
  <rect x='20' y='22' width='60' height='62' rx='16' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <!-- top flap -->
  <path d='M22 40 Q50 20 78 40 L78 46 Q50 30 22 46 Z' fill='#62c6ff'/>
  <!-- flap edge -->
  <path d='M22 46 Q50 30 78 46' fill='none' stroke='#b6e8ff' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- front pocket -->
  <rect x='30' y='52' width='40' height='26' rx='9' fill='#62c6ff'/>
  <rect x='30' y='52' width='40' height='26' rx='9' fill='none' stroke='#b6e8ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- buckle -->
  <rect x='44' y='40' width='12' height='8' rx='2' fill='#ffd84d'/>
  <rect x='46' y='42' width='8' height='4' rx='1' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <!-- face: eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='60' r='4.5' fill='#1b3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='60' r='4.5' fill='#1b3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='58.5' r='1.6' fill='#eaf6ff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='58.5' r='1.6' fill='#eaf6ff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 66 Q50 74 60 66' fill='none' stroke='#1b3a5c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='66' r='3' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='66' r='3' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- side pouch -->
  <rect x='16' y='56' width='8' height='16' rx='4' fill='#2b7fd6'/>
  <rect x='76' y='56' width='8' height='16' rx='4' fill='#2b7fd6'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M44 22 Q50 12 56 22' fill='none' stroke='#a9743f' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
